title: Proration Charge on Paloma Business Plan Upgrades
content:
**Proration clause.** The proration charge of a Paloma Business upgrade is the higher plan's monthly fee times the unused days over the period's days, rounded half up to the cent, less the subscription charge collected for the current billing period times the unused days over the period's days, rounded half up to the cent, never below 0.00, the unused days running from the upgrade date to the last day of the period, both days included.

### The clause in its parts

| Part | Definition |
|---|---|
| Unused days | From the upgrade date to the last day of the current billing period, both days included |
| Period's days | From the first day to the last day of the current billing period, both days included |
| Share of the period settled | The unused days over the period's days |
| Higher plan's part | The higher plan's monthly fee times the share settled, rounded half up to the cent |
| Collected part | The subscription charge collected for the current billing period (the subscription fee entries booked for that period) times the share settled, rounded half up to the cent |
| Proration charge | The higher plan's part less the collected part, never below 0.00, rounded half up to the cent |

### Worked figure (hypothetical: Paloma Business Essentials to Paloma Business Growth)

Period 1 June to 30 June, 30 days; upgrade on 21 June; unused days 21 June through 30 June, 10; subscription charge collected for the period 19.00 USD; the higher plan's monthly fee 49.00 USD.

1. Higher plan's part: 49.00 multiplied by 10 over 30 is 16.333..., rounded half up to 16.33.
2. Collected part: 19.00 multiplied by 10 over 30 is 6.333..., rounded half up to 6.33.
3. Proration charge: 16.33 less 6.33, that is 10.00 USD.

When the collected part is larger than the higher plan's part the proration charge is 0.00.
